description: A Backbone view for the Drupal toolbar element, handling mouse and touch interactions, rendering, and dynamic updates of toolbar components.

classes.name: Drupal.toolbar.ToolbarVisualView
classes.description: A Backbone view managing the Drupal toolbar's visual interactions, rendering, and dynamic behavior.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Defines event handlers for click and touch events on toolbar elements.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the view, sets up event listeners, and triggers initial rendering.

methods.name: updateToolbarHeight
methods.description: Calculates and sets the height of the toolbar element based on its components.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the toolbar's visual state, including tabs, orientation, and subtrees.

methods.name: onTabClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on toolbar tabs, toggling active states.

methods.name: onOrientationToggleClick
methods.description: Handles toggling of toolbar tray orientation between vertical and horizontal.

methods.name: updateTabs
methods.description: Updates active/inactive states of tabs and associated trays.

methods.name: updateBarAttributes
methods.description: Updates attributes of the toolbar bar element based on orientation.

methods.name: updateTrayOrientation
methods.description: Adjusts the orientation of toolbar trays and related UI elements.

methods.name: adjustPlacement
methods.description: Aligns tray positions with the toolbar bar.

methods.name: loadSubtrees
methods.description: Loads admin menu subtrees via AJAX or cache if conditions are met.
